reference_sql:
WITH d3 AS (SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE CAST(order_ts AS DATE) = DATE '2025-03-03' GROUP BY store_id),
d4 AS (SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE CAST(order_ts AS DATE) = DATE '2025-03-04' GROUP BY store_id)
SELECT COALESCE(d3.store_id, d4.store_id) AS store_id, COALESCE(d3.n, 0) AS orders_mar_3, COALESCE(d4.n, 0) AS orders_mar_4
FROM d3
FULL OUTER JOIN d4 ON d4.store_id = d3.store_id
alternatives: SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(order_ts AS DATE) = DATE '2025-03-03') AS orders_mar_3, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(order_ts AS DATE) = DATE '2025-03-04') AS orders_mar_4 FROM orders WHERE CAST(order_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-03' AND DATE '2025-03-04' GROUP BY store_id

solver.query:
SELECT store_id,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(order_ts AS DATE) = DATE '2025-03-03' THEN 1 END) AS orders_mar_3,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(order_ts AS DATE) = DATE '2025-03-04' THEN 1 END) AS orders_mar_4
FROM orders
WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-05 00:00:00'
GROUP BY store_id
